services.name: Improv classes
services.desc: The Neighborhood Comedy Theatre’s Improv Comedy classes & workshops are a wonderful way to start your improv journey! This fun, no-pressure beginning improv comedy class will get you laughing and having a great time whilst clocking plenty of stage time and one on one feedback with your professional comedian instructor. Learn the fundamentals of quick thinking, joke construction, idea generation and development, stage presence and more. Continue exploring the exciting techniques and ideas of improv comedy while adding a focus on performance and game play. services.name: Comedy Shows
services.desc: Every Thursday night, NCT brings something different to the stage - from indie improv teams and experimental formats to teacher-led shows, guest performers, and one-night-only comedy events. The lineup rotates by week, so check the calendar for the exact show happening this Thursday. From true stories turned into improvised scenes to songs made up on the spot, fast-paced comedy games, audience suggestions, and fully unscripted performances, every weekend brings something different to the stage.
